guide.tagline: Gated society with an 18-hole golf course on Raiwind Road, Lahore
guide.overview:
Lake City is a gated society on Main Raiwind Road, Lahore, close to the Lahore Ring Road, built around an 18-hole golf course.

Sectors

Lake City is laid out in residential sectors M-1 to M-8, with sub-sectors such as M-2A, M-3 Extension, M-7A and M-7B, the Golf Enclave and the Business Bay commercial district.

Buying in Lake City

Check a plot's sector, size and dues with the society office before you buy. Browse the houses and plots for sale and rent below, and call or WhatsApp the dealer directly.

faqs.a: Yes, Lake City is built around an 18-hole golf course.
